第47章 穿上警服-《系统送编，从外卖员成007探员》

吃到七点半的时候，菜吃得差不多了，汤也见了底，顾承安放下筷子，说去一趟洗手间。

苏楠“嗯”了一声，继续跟沈悦说话。

顾承安起身，路过前台的时候，掏出手机顺便把单买了。

四百六十二块，不算贵。

等他回到座位，又坐了一会儿，苏楠看了看表，叫服务员结账。

“楠楠，这单我来——”

“哪能让悦悦你来，我约的你嘛，下次你再请吧！”

“你俩不用争了，我已经结过了。”顾承安只好说出。

苏楠动作一顿。

“什么时候结的？”

“刚才去洗手间的时候顺便。”

苏楠放下手，看着他，脸上浮现出一丝无奈的表情：“不是说好了我请吗？”

那语气里带着点嗔怪，配上她微微蹙起的眉头和微张的嘴。

顾承安有些意外。

他接触苏楠以来，一直都是雷厉风行，说一不二，手下的组员也特别服她。这会儿因为一顿饭被抢了买单，居然露出这种表情。

“……确实说好了你请。”顾承安回过神，干咳了一声，“但你这不是还带了朋友嘛，我一个大男人，总不能让两位女士破费。”

苏楠无奈，只好说下次不许和她抢。

沈悦在旁边看戏，嘴角挑起一个好看的弧度。

饭后出了餐厅，夜风吹过来，总算有了几分凉意。

苏楠的车停在路边，一辆黑色的福特SUv，和她气质挺搭的。

“我送你？”苏楠按了下车钥匙。

“不用，我骑了电驴来的，就停那边。”顾承安指了指马路对面，“离我住的地方不远。”

“行，那路上注意安全。”

“好！再见，苏警官，沈小姐再见。”

“拜拜。”沈悦冲他挥了挥手。

顾承安转身过了马路，跨上电驴，拧油门，融入夜色里。

沈悦目送那道身影消失在路口，转过头看向苏楠。

“楠——楠——”嗲声嗲气的说。

“说人话。”

“你是不是看上人家了？”

苏楠正在开车门的手停了下来。

“别胡说。”

“我胡说？你今晚看了他多少眼你自己心里没数？”沈悦凑过来，语气里全是八卦的快乐，“这么多年闺蜜我还不知道你？颜控本控。你今天那个眼神，跟平时可不一样。”

When it was half past seven, the food was almost done and the soup was at the bottom. Gu Chengan put down his chopsticks and said he wanted to go to the bathroom.

Su Nan said "hmm" and continued talking to Shen Yue.

Gu Chengan stood up and when passing by the front desk, he took out his mobile phone and made a purchase.

Four hundred and sixty-two yuan is not expensive.

After he returned to his seat and sat there for a while, Su Nan looked at his watch and asked the waiter to pay.

"Nannan, I'll take care of this order——"

"How can I ask Yueyue to come? I made an appointment with you. Please invite me again next time!"

"You two don't have to argue, I've already settled it." Gu Chengan had no choice but to say.

Su Nan made a move.

"When did you get married?"

"I was just on my way to the bathroom."

Su Nan put down her hand and looked at him, with a helpless expression on her face: "Didn't I agree to invite you?"

There was a bit of anger in her tone, which was matched by her slightly frowned brows and slightly open mouth.

Gu Chengan was a little surprised.

Ever since he came into contact with Su Nan, he had always acted resolutely and kept her word to the letter, and his team members also admired her.Now he had this expression because he was being robbed of paying for a meal.

"...I did agree to invite you." Gu Chengan came back to his senses and coughed dryly, "But didn't you bring a friend with you? I'm a grown man and I can't let these two ladies spend money."

Su Nan had no choice but to say not to rob her next time.

Shen Yue was watching the show next to him, with a nice curve to his lips.

After the meal, I left the restaurant and felt the night breeze blowing, finally feeling a bit cool.

Su Nan's car was parked on the side of the road. It was a black Ford SUV that matched her temperament very well.

"Shall I see you off?" Su Nan pressed the car key.

"No, I rode an electric donkey here. I'll stop over there." Gu Chengan pointed to the other side of the road, "It's not far from where I live."

"Okay, be careful on the road."

"Okay! Goodbye, Officer Su, goodbye Miss Shen."

"Bye." Shen Yue waved to him.

Gu Chengan turned around and crossed the road, got on the eDonkey, turned the accelerator, and blended into the night.

Shen Yue watched the figure disappear at the intersection and turned to look at Su Nan.

"Nan - Nan -" he said in a cooing voice.

"Speak humanly."

"Have you fallen in love with her?"

Su Nan's hand on the car door stopped.

"Don't talk nonsense."

"Am I talking nonsense? You didn't even know how many times you looked at him tonight?" Shen Yue came over, her tone filled with the joy of gossip, "I've been my best friend for so many years, but I still don't know you? You control your appearance and control your appearance. The look in your eyes today is different from usual."
